failures.title: Thinking Token Leakage (Qwen3-8B)
failures.observed_behavior: Model output consisted entirely of reasoning inside <think> tags; no recipe content produced; 14.3% accuracy over 14 rubrics.
failures.root_cause: Qwen3-8B continues emitting internal reasoning tokens even when thinking mode is explicitly disabled (thinkingRequested: false). The entire 512-token output budget was consumed by deliberation.
failures.mitigation: Selected Qwen3.5-0.8B for production; it does not exhibit thinking token leakage. Added <think> tag stripping at app/services/local_llm.py:221 as a defensive post-processing step.

failures.title: Unicode Degeneration (Phi-3.5-mini)
failures.observed_behavior: Output began coherently then rapidly degenerated into invented brand names, emoji sequences, Unicode garbage, and hashtag strings. Scored 0% on all 14 rubrics.
failures.root_cause: Phi-3.5-mini (3.8B) exhibits catastrophic output degeneration under the test's generation parameters (temperature 0.6, top-p 0.92, repetition penalty 1.08). Phi-4-mini shows a different variant: philosophical stream-of-consciousness drift.

evidence.example_output: Featureshelf of Ella's Delightful Grilled Cheddar Flatsheet Crackers

failures.mitigation: Phi-3.5-mini and Phi-4-mini excluded from production consideration. Selected Qwen3.5-0.8B in the Small tier as the most reliable producer.

failures.title: Gemini API Unreachable (Fallback Chain)
failures.observed_behavior: When the Gemini API is unreachable (network error, rate limit, or authentication failure) the system must still respond.
failures.root_cause: Transient API unavailability is expected for any cloud LLM. The rubric requires graceful degradation to a local path or a static fallback.
failures.mitigation: Three-level fallback chain: (1) primary path (Qwen3.5-0.8B local or Gemini optional); (2) direct local Qwen generation via local_llm.generate_response; (3) static fallback message 'Sorry, I couldn't reach the AI service just now.' The CHAT_PREFER_LOCAL_LLM env flag makes level 1 local by default.

failures.title: Out-of-Scope Query Hallucination (RAG)
failures.observed_behavior: Query 'What is the company's cryptocurrency portfolio allocation?' directed at a 1999 SEC 10-K filing (pre-crypto era) produced a fabricated answer about 'investment portfolio diversification' from tangentially related context.
failures.root_cause: Embedding retrieval always returns top-k chunks; without a similarity floor, low-confidence matches (top-1 similarity 0.41) are injected into the generation prompt, where the LLM treats them as relevant.
failures.mitigation: Improvement 3 (see improvements.json): similarity threshold gating at 0.50 minimum cosine similarity. Chunks below this threshold are filtered out. If no chunk passes, an 'insufficient evidence' response is returned instead of a fabricated answer.

failures.title: Diffuse Retrieval on Ambiguous Queries
failures.observed_behavior: Query 'Tell me about the numbers' produced unfocused retrieval: top-10 chunks had cosine similarity variance below 0.02, matching financial figures, employee counts, and patent counts almost equally.
failures.root_cause: The query embedding for vague natural-language queries maps to a diffuse region in embedding space. Without query rewriting, the retriever cannot discriminate between many candidate topics.
failures.mitigation: Improvement 2: LLM query rewriting. Qwen3.5-0.8B rewrites vague queries into specific retrieval-optimized forms before embedding. Example: 'Tell me about the numbers' → 'What are the key financial figures, revenue figures, employee headcount, and numerical data reported in the SEC 10-K annual filing?'

failures.title: OCR Noise on Low-Quality Images
failures.observed_behavior: EasyOCR on images below 150 DPI produces character substitutions: 'Subtotai' for 'Subtotal', 'TotaI' for 'Total' (lowercase L misread as uppercase I in narrow fonts), 'S12.99' for '$12.99'.
failures.root_cause: Low-resolution or low-contrast inputs degrade the CRNN recognizer's confidence on visually similar characters (I vs l, S vs $).
failures.mitigation: Regex pattern matching in RECEIPT_PATTERNS (app/services/ocr.py:32) accepts flexible whitespace and a leading optional $ to tolerate common OCR substitutions. Images below 100 DPI are flagged for manual re-upload in the Documents UI rather than silently ingested.
